description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTrackerAPI class which extends the Endpoint class. It implements CRUD operations (mostly read) for employee tracker data within the performance module of OrangeHRM. The class provides API endpoints to list, retrieve, and filter employee performance trackers, with inline documentation for Swagger/OpenAPI. It references external models, services, and other components relevant to the performance tracking feature.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerAPI
